# BEiT

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/beit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/beit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 7 · **Pretrained weights:** 13 (9 with ImageNet-1k results)

BEiT and BEiT-v2 Vision Transformers, pretrained with masked image modeling. BEiT predicts the discrete visual tokens of
masked patches, BEiT-v2 uses a vector-quantized visual tokenizer for the targets. The weights here are fine-tuned
classification weights.

## Papers

* [BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.08254)
* [BEiT v2: Masked Image Modeling with Vector-Quantized Visual Tokenizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.06366)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('beit_base_patch16_224.in22k_ft_in22k_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```
